entities.name: Otrimi
entities.description: Legendary nightmare beast of Ikoria, mischievous and playful, thought by Vivien Reid to be the larval stage of Brokkos's species.

entities.name: Zagoth
entities.description: Swamps of Ikoria where Otrimi makes its home among giant roots.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who theorizes about Otrimi's nature.

entities.name: Brokkos
entities.description: Apex monster whose species Otrimi may be the larval stage of.

events.summary: Vivien Reid theorizes Otrimi is the larval stage of Brokkos's species, based on its eyes and horns.
events.quote: The planeswalker Vivien Reid theorizes Otrimi is the larval stage of the apex monster
